About

An emerging geospatial professional

I hold a BSc in Geography and Regional Planning from the University of Cape Coast, Ghana, and I am building practical expertise in geospatial technologies.

My interests span GIS, Remote Sensing, geospatial science, spatial planning, environmental GIS and spatial analysis, along with GIS automation and AI-assisted geospatial workflows. I use these tools to investigate real-world environmental, urban, infrastructure and planning questions.

My work so far comes from academic projects and practical exposure, and I am looking to grow through further study, internships and research collaboration.
